reference_sql:
WITH product_units AS (
  SELECT product_id, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  WHERE parent_category = 'TV & Video'
  GROUP BY product_id
),
versions AS (
  SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS n_versions
  FROM price_history
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT u.product_id, u.units, v.n_versions
FROM product_units u
JOIN versions v ON v.product_id = u.product_id

WITH product_units AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(units) AS units FROM sales WHERE parent_category = 'TV & Video' GROUP BY 1), versions AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(valid_from) AS n_versions FROM price_history GROUP BY 1) SELECT u.product_id, u.units, v.n_versions FROM versions v JOIN product_units u ON u.product_id = v.product_id

solver.query:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT product_id, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  WHERE parent_category = 'TV & Video'
  GROUP BY product_id
), versions AS (
  SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS n_versions
  FROM price_history
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT s.product_id, s.units, COALESCE(v.n_versions, 0) AS n_versions
FROM sold s
LEFT JOIN versions v ON v.product_id = s.product_id
